# Kassey's Kitchen

> Home bakery in Fullerton, CA. Cookies, banana bread, chocolate conchas, mini cake loaves, cookie party favor bags and dessert catering, made from scratch to order in small batches. Pickup details are confirmed with your order; the exact address is shared then.

## Menu and prices
- Brownie Cookies: $5 for 2
- Chocolate Chip Cookies: $5 for 2
- Mini Banana Bread: $5 each
- Large Banana Bread Loaf: $25
- Chocolate Conchas: $5 each
- Mini Cake Loaves: $5 each (ask about flavors)
- Cookie Party Favor Bags: $5.50 per bag, 2 cookies per bag, minimum 20 bags
- Sweet Treat Table (20 to 40 guests): starting at $250
- Full Dessert Catering (50+ guests): custom quote

## Ordering
- Orders start as a request through the order form; Kassey replies within 24 to 48 hours to confirm details, pricing and the date.
- Lead time: at least 3 to 5 days; catering and large orders at least 2 weeks.
- Pickup details are confirmed with your order. Delivery is available for catering orders for an additional fee.
- Payment: Venmo, Zelle, Apple Cash, Cash App, PayPal, cash. A deposit may be required for custom or catering orders.
- Allergens: made in a home kitchen that handles nuts, dairy, wheat and eggs.
- Contact: galavizkassey@gmail.com
- Instagram: @kasseyskitchen (https://www.instagram.com/kasseyskitchen/)
